name: Slash Commands UI Execution Completion
description: Implement missing slash command UI executions to achieve feature parity with OpenClaw

userStories.title: Implement /whoami command execution
userStories.description: As a user, I want to use /whoami so that I can see my internal Donkey ID, my current active Session ID, and my channel information.
acceptanceCriteria: Add lcaShowWhoami handler in src/donkey/adapters/channel/telegram_runtime.nim
Add lcaShowWhoami handler in src/donkey/adapters/channel/discord_runtime.nim
Render a message containing the mapped UserId (UUID)
Display the current active sessionId from the SessionManager (if active)
Display the raw channel ID (e.g., Telegram Chat ID / Discord User ID)
bash scripts/run_tests.sh passes
bash scripts/check_boundaries.sh passes

userStories.title: Implement interactive /menu command
userStories.description: As a user, I want an interactive /menu so that I can easily navigate and execute commands without typing them out.
acceptanceCriteria: Add lcaShowMenu handler in telegram_runtime.nim and discord_runtime.nim
Group commands into logical categories (Navigation, Configuration, Tasks, System)
Render the menu using inline keyboards (buttons) for category selection
Support multi-page navigation if the menu exceeds channel limits (similar to /models implementation)
bash scripts/run_tests.sh passes
bash scripts/check_boundaries.sh passes

userStories.title: Implement /config UI execution
userStories.description: As a user, I want to use /config so that I can view and manage my runtime configuration interactively.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement UI rendering for cmdConfig in handleTelegramUiCommand and handleDiscordUiCommand
Display current channel preferences (Provider, Model, Thinking, Budget) in a summary
Provide inline buttons to trigger the respective sub-menus (Models, Think, Budget)
bash scripts/run_tests.sh passes
bash scripts/check_boundaries.sh passes

userStories.title: Implement /tasks and /agents UI execution
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see active tasks and available agents so that I know what the system is currently processing or capable of.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement UI rendering for cmdTasks and cmdAgents in channel adapters
/tasks: Show a list of currently running heartbeat tasks or scheduled cron jobs
/agents: Show a list of loaded skills/tools and MCP clients available in the session
bash scripts/run_tests.sh passes
bash scripts/check_boundaries.sh passes

userStories.title: Implement /poll UI execution
userStories.description: As a user, I want to use /poll so that I can view and interact with pending approvals (e.g., tool execution confirmations).
acceptanceCriteria: Implement UI rendering for cmdPoll in channel adapters
Query the system for any pending interactive prompts or approval requests
If empty, render 'No pending approvals.'
bash scripts/run_tests.sh passes
bash scripts/check_boundaries.sh passes

userStories.title: Wire Orchestrator control commands
userStories.description: As a user, I want /stop, /restart, and /bind commands to properly route and execute in the Orchestrator.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement handling for tkStop, tkRestart, and tkBind in src/donkey/app/orchestrator.nim (handleControlTask)
/stop: Should cancel the current ToolLoop and return to idle state
/restart: Should alias to /reset or clear the current session inbox
/bind: Should associate the current channel with a specified agent personality/profile
bash scripts/run_tests.sh passes
bash scripts/check_boundaries.sh passes
